title: Building a Context-Aware Chat Assistant with Memory
summary: This lesson guides you through building a context-aware AI chat assistant that remembers past interactions. You will learn to load a language model, maintain conversation memory of user messages and AI responses, and inject history as context in prompts. This allows the AI to maintain a continuous conversation rather than answering each question in isolation.

sections.text: Scene: A sleek terminal display shows green Python code loading a model using Hugging Face Transformers. A rounded blue rectangle lights up on screen, representing the loaded language model ready to receive prompts.
I wonder...? How do we initialize the AI system before starting a chat?
Answer: We load a language model using a Python library such as Hugging Face Transformers to generate responses.

Scene: Visual memory boxes appear in two distinct colors: blue rectangles for user messages and yellow rectangles for AI responses. They line up neatly inside a vertical tray that stores conversation history.
I wonder...? How does the chat assistant hold onto past information?
Answer: The system maintains conversation memory by storing user messages and AI responses together over time.

Scene: A diagram shows stored conversation history combining with a new user question arrow inside a clear rectangular prompt container. This merged block of text is injected straight into the language model box.
I wonder...? How is previous conversation history sent to the model for a new question?
Answer: We combine the previous conversation history with the new user question and send everything as context in each new prompt.
Scene: A circular arrow loops continuously between a text input line and the output panel. In the first turn, the user inputs 'My name is Ahmed.', and in the next turn asks 'What is my name?'.
I wonder...? What is the result of running a continuous chat loop with memory?
Answer: The AI maintains a conversation and uses context to recall details like Ahmed's name instead of responding to each message independently.

learning_objectives: Load a language model using a Python library such as Hugging Face Transformers
Maintain conversation memory by storing user messages and AI responses
Build context for each prompt by combining conversation history with new questions
Run a continuous chat loop to observe how memory affects model responses

The stored record of previous user messages and AI responses kept across a chat session.
The combined history of past interactions along with the new user question, sent into the model with every prompt.
A continuous system loop allowing a user to submit multiple questions and receive memory-aware responses.
